originalTitle: What Could Surprise Cisco Stock Investors On The Upside?

content:
Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock returned 62% over the past 12 months (as of Ssptember 28, 2026). After that run, you pay 31.8 times its past year’s earnings, against 22.1 for the S&P 500. At that price, the stock appears to assume growth that has not happened yet, so further upside would need something beyond that. So what could still surprise Cisco Systems investors on the upside?

Cisco’s Upside Surprise Could Come From AI Orders

The surprise could come from AI infrastructure for hyperscalers. That is the networking gear Cisco sells to the largest cloud companies. Cisco took $9.3 billion of these orders in fiscal 2026. Management expects $7.5 billion of revenue from this business in fiscal 2027. So Cisco has taken more orders than it plans to count as sales in fiscal 2027.

An order is a customer’s promise to buy. It becomes revenue only when Cisco delivers the equipment. Sometimes orders are larger than the sales forecast. Then sales can come in above that forecast if Cisco delivers sooner than planned.

The business is already growing fast. It made up about 6% of Cisco’s total revenue in fiscal 2026. That was up from less than 2% in fiscal 2025. Cisco also landed three new design wins with hyperscalers in fiscal Q4 2026. A design win means a customer picked Cisco’s Silicon One chips or its optics for a new build. Even after that jump, AI infrastructure is still a small part of Cisco’s sales.

How Much Could AI Add To Cisco’s Sales?

If Cisco hits its AI target, that business would make up about a tenth of its sales in fiscal 2027. That is because Cisco guided for total fiscal 2027 revenue of $72.2 billion to $73.4 billion. So AI would become a real part of Cisco, but most of the company would still be everything else.

Cisco as a whole is also growing faster than it was. Revenue growth rose in every quarter of fiscal 2026, from 7.5% in fiscal Q1 to 17.6% in fiscal Q4. Management said about 5 points of that fiscal Q4 growth came from price increases. Management also said that without AI, the core business would grow at about 10% under its fiscal 2027 guide. Given the high multiple you pay, the price appears to assume that Cisco delivers its fiscal 2027 guide. So one route to an upside surprise would be AI sales that beat Cisco’s own target.

Cisco stock fell nearly 5% on September 22, 2026. The drop came after Piper Sandler analysts raised concerns that industry growth is peaking. The shares are down 9.0% over the past three months, against a 3.5% gain for the S&P 500.

Can Cisco Turn Those Orders Into Sales Faster?

Cisco has not promised it. On the August 12, 2026 call, the question came up whether the AI target was very conservative next to fiscal 2026 orders. Management answered that these orders are very large, uneven, and usually placed well ahead of time. So management called the target a prudent guide for the year.

Management also said comparisons with the prior year get much tougher in the second half of fiscal 2027.

One sign that AI demand is still growing would be more design wins. Management said on the August 12 call that it expects multiple AI design wins over the next six months. With more wins, Cisco would have its gear in more AI systems.

The figure to watch is any AI order update in Cisco’s fiscal Q1 2027 report. If orders keep the pace of fiscal 2026, the $7.5 billion target would look low. But management said such orders are usually placed well ahead of time. If those orders slow, Cisco stock has less room to surprise on the upside.

Beyond CSCO: A Systematic Way To Grow Your Money

Before you decide on CSCO, consider a better choice. Since its inception, the Trefis High Quality (HQ) Portfolio has returned 105%, beating the benchmark that combines the three major indices – the S&P 500, S&P Mid-cap, and Russell 2000. And it did so without taking the concentrated risk that comes with do-it-yourself stock picking.
chineseTitle: 哪些因素会让思科股票投资者感到惊讶？
chineseSummary: 过去 12 个月（截至 2026 年 9 月 28 日），思科系统公司 (CSCO) 的股票回报率为 62%。在那次上涨之后，你需要支付去年市盈率的 31.8 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.1 倍。以这个价格计算，该股似乎假设了尚未发生的增长，因此进一步的上涨需要超出这个水平。那么，哪些方面仍可能令思科系统投资者感到惊讶呢？
chineseContent:
过去 12 个月（截至 2026 年 9 月 28 日），思科系统公司 (CSCO) 的股票回报率为 62%。在那次上涨之后，你需要支付去年市盈率的 31.8 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.1 倍。按照这个价格，该股似乎假设了尚未发生的增长，因此进一步的上涨需要超出这个水平。那么，哪些方面仍能让思科系统投资者感到惊讶呢？

思科的上行惊喜可能来自人工智能订单

惊喜可能来自超大规模企业的人工智能基础设施。这就是思科向最大的云公司出售的网络设备。思科在 2026 财年获得了其中 93 亿美元的订单。管理层预计 2027 财年该业务的收入将达到 75 亿美元。因此，思科获得的订单数量超过了其计划计入 2027 财年销售额的订单数量。

订单是客户购买的承诺。只有当思科交付设备时，它才成为收入。有时订单量大于销售预测。如果思科比计划更早交付，那么销售额可能会高于预测。

该业务已经在快速增长。它约占思科 2026 财年总收入的 6%。这一数字高于 2025 财年的不到 2%。思科还在 2026 财年第四季度赢得了与超大规模企业的三项新设计胜利。设计胜利意味着客户选择了思科的 Silicon One 芯片或其光学器件用于新构建。即使在这一跳跃之后，人工智能基础设施仍然只占思科销售额的一小部分。

人工智能能为思科的销售额带来多少贡献？

如果思科实现其人工智能目标，该业务将占其 2027 财年销售额的十分之一左右。这是因为思科预计 2027 财年总收入为 722 亿美元至 734 亿美元。因此，人工智能将成为思科真正的一部分，但公司的大部分仍将是其他一切。

思科作为一个整体的增长速度也比以前更快。 2026 财年每个季度的收入增长均有所上升，从第一财季的 7.5% 增至第四财季的 17.6%。管理层表示，第四财季增长的约 5 个百分点来自价格上涨。管理层还表示，如果没有人工智能，核心业务将在 2027 财年指导下增长 10% 左右。考虑到您支付的高倍数，该价格似乎假设思科发布了其 2027 财年指南。因此，实现上行惊喜的一个途径是人工智能销售超过思科自己的目标。

2026 年 9 月 22 日，思科股价下跌近 5%。 Piper Sandler 分析师对行业增长即将见顶表示担忧，股价下跌。该股过去三个月下跌 9.0%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨 3.5%。

思科能否更快地将这些订单转化为销售？

思科还没有承诺过。在 2026 年 8 月 12 日的电话会议上，有人提出了人工智能目标相对 2026 财年订单是否非常保守的问题。管理层回答说，这些订单非常大，而且参差不齐，而且通常提前很久下达。因此，管理层称该目标是今年的审慎指引。

管理层还表示，2027 财年下半年与上一年的比较变得更加困难。

人工智能需求仍在增长的一个迹象是更多的设计获胜。管理层在 8 月 12 日的电话会议上表示，预计在未来六个月内将获得多项人工智能设计胜利。随着更多的胜利，思科将在更多的人工智能系统中拥有自己的装备。

值得关注的数字是思科 2027 年第一季度财报中的任何人工智能订单更新。如果订单保持 2026 财年的增长速度，75 亿美元的目标看起来会很低。但管理层表示，此类订单通常会提前很久下达。如果这些订单放缓，思科股票上涨的空间就较小。

超越 CSCO：增加资金的系统方法

在决定选择 CSCO 之前，请考虑更好的选择。自成立以来，Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合的回报率为 105%，超过了结合三大指数（S&P 500、S&P Mid-cap 和 Russell 2000）的基准。而且它没有承担自行选股带来的集中风险。
